title: ⚡ Microsoft unveils the "Maia 300" chip — a new brain powering its AI with higher efficiency!
body: ⚡ Microsoft unveils the "Maia 300" chip — a new brain powering its AI with higher efficiency!
Microsoft announced on Monday, November 16, its new AI chip "Maia 300", which will become the main inference system for all the company's products and services.
The company says the new chip delivers 40% more tokens per megawatt of power, compared with inference systems built on traditional graphics cards — meaning it does more work with less electricity.

The chip is designed specifically for modern AI workloads: long contexts in which models remember huge conversations, memory-heavy tasks, and sequential answer-generation operations, with a precise balance between computing power, memory speed, networks and energy efficiency at huge cloud scale.
"Inference" is the stage of running the model after it has been trained — the moment it answers your question — and it is the stage that consumes most of data centres' energy today.
Simply put: imagine Microsoft built its own engine to run its AI, faster and cheaper than ready-made engines. That is "Maia 300".
Do you think the big companies will all make their own chips instead of buying them?
